description: This file contains extension methods, interface definitions, and configurator classes for setting up Azure Queue streaming providers within Orleans. It includes configuration extensions for Azure Queue options, cache size, and classes for both silo and cluster client stream configurators specific to Azure Queue streams.

classes.name: SiloAzureQueueStreamConfigurator
classes.description: Configurator for setting up Azure Queue stream provider in silo environment, including queue options and cache size.

classes.name: ClusterClientAzureQueueStreamConfigurator
classes.description: Configurator for setting up Azure Queue stream provider in cluster client environment with default queue name logic.

methods.name: ConfigureAzureQueue
methods.description: Extension method to configure Azure Queue options via options builder.

methods.name: ConfigureQueueDataAdapter
methods.description: Extension method to configure a queue data adapter factory for Azure Queue streams.

methods.name: ConfigureQueueDataAdapter<TQueueDataAdapter>
methods.description: Generic extension method to configure a specific queue data adapter type.

methods.name: ConfigureCacheSize
methods.description: Method to configure cache size for Azure Queue stream in silo configurator.

methods.name: SiloAzureQueueStreamConfigurator
methods.description: Class that sets up Azure Queue stream provider for a silo, including default queue name generation.

methods.name: ClusterClientAzureQueueStreamConfigurator
methods.description: Class that sets up Azure Queue stream provider for a cluster client, including default queue name generation.
